DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方をお探しでしょうか。どなたとご一緒でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for someone who came with you? Who were you here with?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 成人の妹と来ました。別の店を見ている間にはぐれて、携帯に電話しても出ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 成人の妹と別の店を見ていてはぐれ電話に出ないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came with my younger sister, who is an adult. We got separated while looking in different shops, and she isn't answering her mobile.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you got separated from your adult younger sister while looking in different shops and she isn't answering the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に会った場所と、待ち合わせを決めていたかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you last saw each other and whether you'd agreed on a meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 服の店の前で別れました。三十分後に会うと言っただけで、場所をはっきり決めていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服の店前で別れ三十分後とだけ決め待合場所が曖昧だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: We split up in front of a clothing shop. We only said we'd meet thirty minutes later and didn't clearly decide where.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you parted outside a clothing shop and agreed only to meet after thirty minutes, with an unclear meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お互いに探して移動すると行き違うことがありますね。まず連絡できる方法と、待つ場所を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you both move around looking for each other, you can miss each other. First, let's decide how to contact her and where you'll wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の携帯ではメッセージを送れます。ここで待っていると書いて、場所の表示の写真を添えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内場所で待つメッセージに場所表示の写真を添えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can send a message on my mobile. May I write that I'm waiting here and attach a photo of the location sign?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can attach a photo of the location sign to a message saying you are waiting at the information point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所が分かる表示を写す際は、周りの方が写らないようにしてください。館内放送の扱いも必要なら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: When photographing a sign that identifies the location, please avoid including people around you. If needed, I'll also check the arrangements for a building announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まずメッセージを送ります。放送を頼むかは少し待ってから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まずメッセージを送り少し待ってから館内放送を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send a message first. I'd like to wait a little before discussing whether to request an announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will send a message first and discuss a building announcement after waiting a little. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内場所にいると伝えて、移動する場合は再度連絡してください。返信は届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell her you're at this information point, and contact her again if you move. Have you received a reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 妹から返信が来ました。この表示を見て来るそうなので、私はこちらを離れず待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 妹から返信があり表示を見て来るためその場を離れず待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: My sister has replied. She says she'll use this sign to find her way here, so I'll stay right here and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your sister replied and will use the sign to come here, so you will stay where you are and wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡が取れてよかったです。合流後に次の待ち合わせも決めておくとよいですね。それでは、お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you've made contact. Once you're together, it's good to decide your next meeting point too. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋へ入れないとのことですね。鍵の状態を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can't get into your room. Could you tell me what happened with the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードキーを机に置いたまま出て、ドアが閉まりました。部屋に戻るための方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードキーを机に置いて出たためドアが閉まり戻る方法を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I went out leaving my key card on the desk, and the door closed. I'd like advice on how to get back into my room.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you left the key card on the desk and the door closed, and ask how to get back in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご宿泊のお名前と部屋番号を伺います。確認できるものはお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I have the booking name and room number? Do you have anything with you that we can use to verify them?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約したファンです。七一二号室で、携帯には予約メールがあります。身分証は部屋のかばんに入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名ファンと七一二号室とメールがあり身分証は部屋と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: The reservation is under Fan. It's room 712, and I have the booking email on my mobile. My identification is in my bag in the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the booking name Fan and room 712, say you have the email, and explain that your identification is in the room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宿泊の記録と確認方法を照合します。同じお部屋に泊まっている方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare the accommodation record and verification methods. Is anyone else staying in the same room?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夫と二人ですが、夫は今ホテルの外です。夫の鍵を待つより先に、こちらで確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夫も宿泊しているが外出中で先にフロントの確認を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: My husband and I are staying together, but he's outside the hotel now. Rather than waiting for his key, I'd like you to check here first.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your husband is also staying but is out, and you would like reception to check first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入室の方法は本人確認ができてからご案内します。部屋番号だけでは対応できませんので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to enter once we've verified your identity. The room number alone isn't enough, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約メールを見せます。ここで確認できなければ、夫に連絡して戻る時間を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約メールを示し確認できなければ夫へ戻る時間を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll show you the booking email. If you can't verify it here, I'll contact my husband and ask when he'll return.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the booking email and say you will ask your husband when he will return if verification isn't possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メールの必要な箇所を確認しますね。新しい鍵などをお渡しする場合の扱いも、担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the necessary parts of the email. I'll also ask the person in charge about the procedure if we issue a new key or similar.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に確認をお願いします。部屋へ入れたら身分証を持って来ますので、必要な確認が残るかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入室後に身分証を持って来るので残る確認があるか教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check first. Once I can get in, I'll bring my identification, so please also tell me whether any checks will remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask what checks will remain because you will bring your identification after entering the room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認方法を整理してご説明します。お部屋へお戻りの際は鍵もお確かめください。それでは、どうぞゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll organize the verification procedure and explain it. When returning to your room, please check that you have your key too. Enjoy your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 催しをご覧になる方ですね。通路ではお荷物を広げず、まずご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to watch the event. Please ask us first rather than spreading your belongings out in the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳み椅子を持ってきました。ここがよく見えそうですが、この場所で使ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参した折り畳み椅子を見やすい今の場所で使ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a folding chair. This spot seems to have a good view; may I use it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use your own folding chair at your current spot with a good view. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは人が通るため、椅子を置かないでください。持参の椅子を使える場所があるか、運営に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: People pass through here, so please don't put a chair here. I'll ask the organizers whether there's somewhere you can use your own chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ広げずに持っておきます。友人も椅子を持っているので、二人分使える場所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 椅子を広げず友人の分も含め二人が使える場所を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll keep holding it without unfolding it. My friend has a chair too, so I'd like to know about a place where two of us can use them.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you won't unfold the chair and want a place for two people, including your friend, to use theirs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数も含めて確認します。会場の備え付けの席をご利用になる方法も考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the number of people too. Using the venue's provided seating may also be an option.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分たちの椅子を使えなければ、持ったまま備え付けの席へ行ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参椅子不可なら椅子を持って備え付けの席へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: If we can't use our own chairs, may we carry them with us to the provided seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take your own chairs to the provided seating if you can't use them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 備え付けの席での荷物の置き方も確認しましょう。椅子の脚や袋が通路へ出ないようにする必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check how belongings should be stored at the provided seats too. The chair legs and bags mustn't stick out into the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 椅子は畳んで袋に入れられます。隣の空席へ置くのではなく、自分の足元で収まるか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 椅子を袋へ畳み空席に置かず自分の足元に収まるか確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: We can fold the chairs and put them in bags. Rather than putting mine on the empty seat next to me, I'll check whether it fits by my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will fold the chair into its bag and check whether it fits by your feet instead of using an empty seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で受付へご相談ください。持参の椅子が使えるという確認はまだ取れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask at reception with it in that condition. We haven't yet confirmed that your own chairs can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にも、ここでは広げないと伝えます。受付で二人分の席と荷物の置き方を聞き、使える場所が決まってから座ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ通路で広げないと伝え受付で席と荷物位置を確認してから座ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend not to unfold a chair here either. At reception, I'll ask about seats for two and where to put our belongings, and sit only once an allowed place has been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend not to unfold a chair in the passage, check seats and storage at reception, and then sit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通路を空けていただきありがとうございます。それでは、係の案内に沿って催しをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for keeping the passage clear. Please enjoy the event following the staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘の修理についてでしょうか。気になる部分を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about an umbrella repair? Please tell me which part concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ち手にひびが入りました。まだ使えますが、急に折れるのが心配なので、直せるか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘の持ち手にひびがあり折れる心配から修理できるか見てほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: The handle is cracked. I can still use it, but I'm worried it might suddenly snap, so I'd like you to see whether it can be repaired.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the umbrella handle is cracked and you want a repair assessment because you're worried it may snap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ひびの場所を拝見します。強く曲げず、そのままお持ちください。いつごろ気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the crack. Please hold it as it is without bending it hard. When did you notice it?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日畳むときに気づきました。骨ではなく、この持ち手の付け根です。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日畳む際に気づき骨ではなく持ち手の付け根のひびと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday when folding it. It's at the base of this handle, not the ribs.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed the crack yesterday while folding the umbrella and that it is at the handle's base, not the ribs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 修理できるか、部品を交換する必要があるかを確認します。ご購入先や製品の情報は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether it can be repaired or needs a replacement part. Do you know where it was bought or have product information?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで買った物ではありません。傘のタグにメーカー名は残っていますが、保証書はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他店購入でメーカー名のタグはあるが保証書はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I didn't buy it here. The manufacturer's name is still on the umbrella tag, but I don't have the warranty.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you bought it elsewhere and have a manufacturer's tag but no warranty. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付できる品か確認してから、費用と期間をご案内します。見積もりを聞いてから修理するか決められるかも確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking whether we can accept this item, we'll explain the cost and time. I'll also check whether you can decide on repairs after hearing the estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に金額を知りたいです。高ければ買い替えも考えるので、確認だけで料金が掛かるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理額次第で買替えを考えるため見積もりや確認だけの費用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to know the amount first. If it's expensive, I might buy a new one, so please tell me whether just checking it costs anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about costs for an estimate or inspection alone because you may replace it depending on the repair cost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見積もりや確認に費用が掛かる場合は、進める前に説明します。無断で修理には進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: If there's a charge for the estimate or inspection, we'll explain before proceeding. We won't begin repairs without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから預けるか決めます。今日は手元で見ていただく範囲にして、持ち手を無理に使わず持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に預けるか決め当日は手元の確認にとどめ無理に使わず持ち帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide whether to leave it after hearing the explanation. Today, please only inspect it here while I keep it with me; I'll take it home without forcing the handle during use.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide whether to leave it after the explanation, limit today to an inspection while keeping it, and take it home without forcing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付の条件から確認しますね。移動の際もひびの部分に力をかけないようにしてください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll start by checking the acceptance conditions. Please avoid putting force on the cracked part while carrying it too. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音声案内の操作で何かお困りですか。音は聞こえていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble operating the audio guide? Can you hear the sound?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 音は聞こえますが、英語になっています。日本語の説明を聞きたいので、言語を変えられるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音は聞こえるが英語で日本語に切り替えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can hear it, but it's in English. I'd like to hear the Japanese explanation, so I want to know whether I can change the language.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the sound works but is in English, and ask whether you can switch to Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この機器で選べる言語を確認しましょう。今はどの展示番号を入力されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the languages available on this device. Which exhibit number have you entered?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十二番です。展示の番号と機器の番号が同じなら、それだけで日本語になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二十二番を入力し展示番号一致で日本語になると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number 22. I thought that if the exhibit number and device number matched, that alone would make it Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered 22 and thought matching the exhibit number would make it Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 展示番号と言語の選択は別です。日本語を選ぶ表示をご案内しますので、再生をいったん止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The exhibit number and language selection are separate. I'll show you how to select Japanese, so please stop playback for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 止めました。設定を変えた後、二十二番をもう一度入れれば、最初から聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再生を止め設定後に二十二番再入力で最初から聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've stopped it. After changing the setting, can I listen from the beginning by entering 22 again?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop playback and ask whether reentering 22 after changing the setting will play it from the start. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最初から再生する操作も一緒に確認しましょう。この表示で言語を選んだ後、展示番号の画面へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check how to play from the beginning too. After choosing the language here, return to the exhibit-number screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日本語の表示を選べました。聞いている間にほかの展示へ進むと、説明と場所がずれそうなので、ここで聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日本語を選べたと伝え説明と展示をずらさないためその場で聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've selected the Japanese option. If I move to another exhibit while listening, the explanation and location may get out of step, so I'll listen here.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you selected Japanese and will listen where you are so that the explanation matches the exhibit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 展示を特定してから聞くと分かりやすいですね。音量は周りの方に響かない範囲で調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's easier to understand when you identify the exhibit before listening. Please adjust the volume so it doesn't carry to people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 音量を下げました。二十二番の展示の前で聞き、次へ移るときは新しい番号を入力します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 音量を下げ今の展示で聞き次へ移る時は新しい番号を入力すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've turned it down. I'll listen in front of exhibit 22 and enter a new number when I move to the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you lowered the volume, will listen at the current exhibit, and enter a new number when moving on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 設定ができてよかったです。返却の案内も最後にご確認ください。それでは、展示をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad it's set up. Please also check the return instructions at the end. Enjoy the exhibition.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 島へ渡るご予定ですね。お荷物についてもご相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're planning to go to the island. Do you also have a question about luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車を持って行きたいです。人の切符だけ先に買ってよいのか、自転車の分も一緒に確認した方がよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人の券を先に買うか自転車の扱いも同時に確認するか迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take my bicycle. I'm unsure whether to buy only my passenger ticket first or check the bicycle arrangements at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you're unsure whether to buy the passenger ticket first or check the bicycle arrangements at the same time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 船の種類や便によって扱いが違いますので、購入前に確認しましょう。折り畳み式でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Arrangements vary by boat type and sailing, so let's check before you buy. Is it a folding bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 折り畳みではなく、普通の自転車です。輪行袋にも入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折畳みではない普通の自転車で輪行袋にも入れていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's a regular bicycle, not a folding one. It isn't in a bicycle travel bag either.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it's a regular, nonfolding bicycle and isn't in a bicycle travel bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用予定の便で運べるか、受付と料金を確認します。渡る日と、希望する時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check whether it can be carried on your intended sailing, the acceptance procedure, and the fee. Please tell me the date and preferred time of day.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午前中です。自転車が載せられないなら、別の便に変えることも考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明日の午前に渡り積載不可なら別便も考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tomorrow morning. If I can't load the bicycle, I'm also considering a different sailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to cross tomorrow morning and may choose another sailing if the bicycle can't be loaded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 積載の可否に加えて、事前の連絡が必要かも確認します。島から戻る予定の便についても確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Along with whether it can be loaded, I'll check whether advance contact is required. Would you also like to check your planned return sailing from the island?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは明日の夕方です。行きだけ運べても困るので、往復とも条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日夕方に戻るため往復とも自転車の条件を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm returning tomorrow evening. It would be a problem if it could only go one way, so I'd like the conditions for both directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you're returning tomorrow evening and want the bicycle conditions for both directions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きと帰りを分けて確認します。まだ利用できると決まっていないので、券は案内を聞いてからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the outward and return trips separately. Availability isn't confirmed yet, so please choose your tickets after hearing the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方の条件が分かるまで買わずに待ちます。難しければ自転車を持たずに行く案も検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両便の条件確認まで買わず難しければ自転車なしの案も検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait without buying until I know both sets of conditions. If it's difficult, I'll also consider going without the bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't buy until both sailings' conditions are checked and will consider going without the bicycle if necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 便ごとの案内を確認しますね。自転車は通行の妨げにならない所でお持ちください。それでは、島での旅もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the information for each sailing. Please keep your bicycle where it doesn't obstruct people passing. Enjoy your island trip too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの記帳用紙について、ご案内が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need some guidance with this registration form?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前を書く欄がありますが、カタカナで書くべきか、自分の国の文字で書いてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳用紙にカタカナか自分の国の文字で書くか迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a space for my name, but I'm unsure whether to write it in katakana or whether I can use my country's script.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you're unsure whether to use katakana or your country's script on the registration form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この用紙でお願いしている書き方を確認します。読み方も記入できる欄がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the writing style requested on this form. There's a field for the pronunciation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はローマ字で書けます。日本語の読み方を横に添えた方が、呼ばれたときに分かりやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ローマ字で書けるが日本語の読みを付ける方が確認しやすいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can write my name in Roman letters. Would adding the Japanese pronunciation beside it make it easier to recognize when I'm called?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can use Roman letters and ask whether adding the Japanese pronunciation would make checking easier. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読み方をカタカナで添えていただければ確認しやすいです。お名前の順番は、ご本人が使う表記でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: Adding the pronunciation in katakana makes it easier to check. Please use the name order that you normally use.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ローマ字の下にカタカナを書きます。名前が長いので、枠から少し出てしまいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ローマ字の下にカタカナを書くが長くて枠を超えそうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll write katakana below the Roman letters. My name is long, so it may extend a little beyond the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will write katakana below the Roman letters but your long name may exceed the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に小さくして読めなくせず、余白を使えるか確認しましょう。欄の続きをこちらへ書く方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Rather than making it so small that it's unreadable, let's check whether you can use the margin. I'll show you where to continue the field here.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。途中の名前を勝手に省略せず、全部書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前の途中を省略せず全部書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'd like to write it all without arbitrarily shortening the middle of my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to write your whole name without omitting any middle part. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その表記で構いません。個人情報がある用紙ですので、書き終えたらほかの方に見えないようこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: That spelling is fine. The form contains personal information, so once you've finished, please hand it to us here so others can't see it.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読み方も付けて全部書けました。この用紙は机に残さず、係の方へ直接渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読みを付け全名を書けたと伝え机に残さず係へ渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my whole name with the pronunciation. I won't leave the form on the desk; I'll give it directly to the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have written the full name with pronunciation and will hand the form to staff instead of leaving it on the desk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。表記を確かめていただきありがとうございました。それでは、境内の見学もどうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take it. Thank you for checking the spelling. Please take your time looking around the temple or shrine grounds too.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの運搬の合図は伝わりましたか。まだ開始していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you understand the signal for moving the load just now? You haven't started yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 機械の音で声が聞こえませんでした。進める合図か止まる合図か分からず、作業を始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機械音で進行か停止の合図が分からず開始していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't hear the voice because of the machinery noise. I didn't know whether it meant proceed or stop, so I haven't started work.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that machinery noise made the proceed-or-stop signal unclear and you haven't started. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不明なまま始めなくてよいです。安全な場所で合図を確認しましょう。ほかの作業員には何と伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's fine not to start when it's unclear. Let's confirm the signals in a safe place. What did you tell the other workers?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私には合図が分からないので、開始を待ってほしいと伝えました。勝手に進める指示は出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 合図が不明なので待つよう伝え独断の開始指示は出していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I told them I couldn't understand the signal and asked them to wait before starting. I haven't given an instruction to proceed on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you asked them to wait because the signal was unclear and didn't independently order a start. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま待機してください。騒音のある時の連絡方法と、合図を出す担当者を統一します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please stay on standby. We'll standardize communication in noisy conditions and designate one person to give signals.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手の合図を使う場合も、意味を全員で確かめたいです。似た動きで勘違いしないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手合図も全員で意味を確かめ似た動きの誤解を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if we use hand signals, I'd like everyone to check their meanings together. I want to avoid confusion from similar movements.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want everyone to check hand signals' meanings to avoid misunderstanding similar movements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 決めた合図を全員で確認してから使います。誰からの合図を見るかも含めて、作業前の説明をやり直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll use the agreed signals only after everyone has checked them. We'll repeat the pre-work briefing, including whose signals to watch.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。合図を確認できない時は、止まって担当者に知らせるという理解でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合図を確認できない時は止まり担当者へ知らせる理解でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Is my understanding correct that if I can't confirm a signal, I should stop and tell the person in charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether stopping and informing the person in charge is the right response when a signal can't be confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、不明な時は停止して確認です。機械の近くへ寄って声を聞こうとはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, stop and check whenever it's unclear. Don't go near the machinery to try to hear the voice.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停止と確認の手順を仲間にも伝えます。説明を聞いて自分で合図の意味を言い直してから、再開の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止確認の手順を仲間へ伝え説明後に合図を言い直して再開指示を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my coworkers the stop-and-check procedure too. After hearing the explanation and restating the signals' meanings myself, I'll wait for the instruction to resume.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the stop-and-check procedure, restate the signals after the explanation, and wait for a resumption instruction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、安全な場所で説明します。確認できたら次の指示を出します。それでは、いったん失礼します。再開の指示まで待機をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain in a safe place. Once we've confirmed everything, I'll give the next instruction. Goodbye for now; please remain on standby until the instruction to resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 連絡先のご変更ですね。どの情報を変更されたいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to change your contact details. Which information would you like to update?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯電話の番号です。古い番号は解約したので、銀行からの連絡がそちらへ行かないように直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧携帯番号を解約したため銀行の連絡が旧番号へ行かないよう変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mobile number. I canceled the old number, so I want to update it to keep bank communications from going there.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you canceled the old mobile number and want to change it so bank communications don't go to the old number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更の手続きと、ご本人の確認が必要です。新しい番号は、今ご利用になれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to carry out the change procedure and verify your identity. Can you use the new number now?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい携帯は使えます。番号のメモもありますが、書き間違いがないか画面と見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新携帯は使用可で番号のメモを画面と比べ書き間違いを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new mobile works. I have a note of the number, but I'd like to compare it with the screen to check for copying errors.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the new phone works and you want to compare the number note with the screen to check for errors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の携帯の番号表示を見て確認してください。手続きに必要な書類についてもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the number displayed on your own phone. I'll also explain the documents needed for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面とメモが一致しました。窓口の登録を変えれば、アプリで使う番号も自動で変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号が一致したと伝え窓口の変更でアプリの番号も自動変更されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: The screen and note match. If I change the registration at the counter, does the number used in the app change automatically too?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the number matches and ask whether a counter update automatically changes the app's number too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 窓口への登録とアプリの設定は扱いが異なる場合があります。ご利用のサービスを確認して、必要な変更を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: The counter registration and app settings may be handled differently. We'll check the services you use and explain the required changes separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: アプリも使っています。自動で変わると思わず、どの設定を別に直すか一覧で知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アプリも利用し自動変更と決めず別途必要な設定を一覧で知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I use the app too. Rather than assume it changes automatically, I'd like a list of the settings I need to update separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you use the app and ask for a list of separate settings without assuming automatic updates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が必要な項目を整理します。通知を受け取れるかは、変更後にサービスごとの案内に沿って確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll organize the items that need checking. After the change, please follow each service's instructions to check whether you can receive notifications.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口とアプリの手順をメモします。古い番号では受け取れないので、新しい番号で確認する方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口とアプリの手順をメモし新番号で通知確認する方法も教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the counter and app procedures. I can't receive anything at the old number, so please also show me how to check using the new number.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the counter and app steps and ask how to check notifications at the new number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 手続きと確認方法を順にご案内します。メモに番号を残す際は管理にもご注意ください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the procedure and checks in order. Please also handle any written record of the number carefully. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に東の出口で待つと言われましたが、どこかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から聞いた待ち合わせ先がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend told me to wait at the east exit, but I don't know where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you don't know the meeting location your friend mentioned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出口の名前が書かれたメッセージはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a message with the exit's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。「駅を出て右の時計の下」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届いたメッセージの具体的な内容を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. It says, “Leave the station and wait under the clock on the right.”
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the specific content of the message you received. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図では時計が二つありますね。友達に写真を送ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map shows two clocks. Could you ask your friend to send a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真をお願いしてみます。待っている間、この辺にいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真を依頼しながら待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask for a photo. May I stay around here while waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where you can wait while requesting a photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、案内板の横でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait beside the information board and keep the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真が来ました。この赤い柱は図のどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた写真の柱を案内図で探してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The photo has arrived. Where is this red pillar on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for help finding the pillar in the photo on the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ここに示した柱です。友達には今いる場所も伝えておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's the pillar marked here. It would be good to tell your friend where you are now too.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内板の写真を送って、ここまで迎えに来てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地の写真を送り友人に迎えを頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll send a photo of this information board and ask my friend to come and get me here.
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will send a photo of your current location and ask your friend to come for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: これで互いの場所がわかりましたね。お友達と合流できたら、気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-038-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now you know each other's locations. Once you meet up with your friend, have a safe outing.
